children: JATT III Acquisition consummated an IPO and related private placement, raising $69,000,000 placed in trust and $2,340,000 from sponsor shares.
Completed IPO of 6,900,000 ordinary shares at $10.00 each, including full 900,000-share overallotment, grossing $69,000,000.
Simultaneously sold 234,000 private placement shares to sponsor at $10.00 each, generating $2,340,000 in gross proceeds.
$69,000,000 of net proceeds (including $2,070,000 deferred underwriting fee) deposited in trust account for public shareholders.
Auditor WithumSmith+Brown issued unqualified opinion on audited balance sheet as of August 27, 2026 included as Exhibit 99.1.
Transaction costs totaled $2,988,379; deferred underwriting fee of $2,070,000 payable from trust only if a business combination occurs.
